rationale: Vadym's deep expertise building user-friendly crypto products at Trustee complements Spencer's active development across blockchain infrastructure and web3 applications—they're both solving different layers of the same ecosystem. With Vadym's 16+ years in blockchain development and conviction around accessibility, plus Spencer's hands-on work with autonomous agents and on-chain systems, there's potential to explore how consumer-facing crypto products could integrate or benefit from the infrastructure and application patterns BlockSpaceForce is building.
intro_message: Vadym Hrusha, meet Spencer Yang — both shipping in crypto/blockchain with complementary angles: Vadym on mainstream user adoption through Trustee's wallets, Spencer on autonomous agents and web3 infrastructure at BlockSpaceForce.
